description: Where a wallet stands on the way to a funded Cubicle vault, read from the chain (gas, USDG in the wallet, its accounts, the factory's invite gate), and the ONE next step with the tool that does it: connect, add gas, open a vault (vault_prepare), buy USDG with a card (fund_with_card) or send it, fund the vault (vault_prepare), or ready. Also `path`: the account's whole way from join to withdraw in eight steps (join, sign in, second factor, wallets, plan, vault, trade, withdraw), each done, next, later or blocked with the reason, and `path.next_step`. Call it first, and again after every step the trader signs.

chain.description: 4663 Robinhood Chain (real money, the default) or 36927 the devnet (test money)

owner.description: the 0x address of the trader's wallet (defaults to the wallet linked to this principal)

name: onboard
